prompt: Why does the digest call for a paper bag when packing a bowl?
promptZh: 為什麼外帶時要使用紙袋？
evidence: Toast will stay crisp in a dry bag, but it will soften if packed on top of the moist beans.

options.text: To keep lemon juice from spilling.
options.why: A screw-top cup holds the lemon.

options.text: To keep the entire meal warm.
options.why: The bag is for a dry topping, not the beans or the meal’s temperature.
options.whyZh: 紙袋用來裝乾配料，並不裝豆子或用來保溫。

options.text: To stop the surface of the beans from drying out.
options.why: The beans stay in the bowl; the concern is wet toast.
options.whyZh: 豆子留在碗裡，文中擔心的是吐司受潮。

options.text: To keep a topping away from the beans’ moisture.
options.zh: 讓配料不接觸豆子的水氣。
options.why: Dry separation preserves the toast’s texture.
options.whyZh: 分開乾燥存放可以維持吐司酥脆。
